info.title: Portitor issuer
info.description: The public HTTP interface of portitor-issuer (ADR 0018): the issuer's did:web DID document, the DCP v1.0.1 issuer service (metadata, credential request, request status) and the Bitstring Status List credentials. Message bodies follow the DCP v1.0.1 JSON Schemas (copies in crates/portitor-dcp/tests/schemas, linked from each operation). Issued credentials are delivered to the holder's Storage API, not answered here. The management API is described separately in issuer-management-openapi.json. Written by hand; a test checks that every operation here is served.

servers.description: The issuer's public address (PORTITOR_BIND behind HTTPS)

get.description: Served at the path the did:web method gives for PORTITOR_PARTICIPANT_ID: /.well-known/did.json for a DID without a path, /<path>/did.json otherwise. One P-256 verification method (assertionMethod, capabilityInvocation) and the IssuerService entry (PORTITOR_ISSUER_SERVICE_URL).
One CredentialObject per credential definition (PORTITOR_ISSUER_CREDENTIALS_FILE); its id is the definition's, stable across restarts. Open to anyone.

post.summary: Credential Request API: a holder asks for credentials (DCP 6.4)
post.description: Only registered participants may call; anyone else gets 401, and nothing is recorded. The request is recorded RECEIVED and decided in the background: ISSUED if every id is in the metadata, the holder stays within the limit of active credentials per definition (PORTITOR_ISSUER_MAX_ACTIVE_PER_HOLDER) and the status list has room, REJECTED otherwise. Issued credentials go, in one CredentialMessage, to the holder's Storage API (the CredentialService of its DID document), with a self-issued ID token of the issuer whose token claim carries back the access token of the request's token. A rejection is not delivered; the holder reads the request status.

Location.description: The absolute URL of the request status, <issuerService>/requests/<issuerPid>

400.description: Not a valid CredentialRequestMessage, an empty holderPid or an empty credentials array

401.description: The caller was refused: not a registered participant, or its token is not valid

409.description: This holder made a request with this holderPid before; nothing is issued again

get.description: Only the holder that made the request may read it; another registered participant gets 404, as for an unknown id, and a caller that is not registered gets 401. The status is RECEIVED, then ISSUED or REJECTED, and never changes after that.

parameters.name: issuerPid
parameters.description: The last part of the Location of the request

401.description: The caller was refused: not a registered participant, or its token is not valid

404.description: No such request for this caller

get.summary: A status list credential (W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0)
get.description: vc11 for the credentials of profile vc11-sl2021/jwt, vc20 for vc20-bssl/jwt. A BitstringStatusListCredential (VC Data Model 2.0, signed JWT) of 131,072 entries, purpose revocation, signed again after each revocation.

selfIssuedIdToken.description: A self-issued ID token of the holder (DCP base protocol, section 4.3), aud the issuer's DID, checked against the holder's DID document
